! 2D MUSCL reconstruction with the MC (monotonized-central) limiter.
! One scalar field per call; the caller calls separately for h, hu, hv.
module dynamics_shallow_water_reconstruction_2d_muscl_mc_model
  use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
  implicit none
  private

  integer, parameter :: dp = real64

  public :: dp
  public :: dynamics_shallow_water_reconstruction_2d_muscl_mc__reconstruct

contains

  subroutine dynamics_shallow_water_reconstruction_2d_muscl_mc__reconstruct(nx, ny, ng, &
      nx_total, ny_total, U_in, U_L, U_R, U_B, U_T, grid_valid)
    integer, intent(in) :: nx
    integer, intent(in) :: ny
    integer, intent(in) :: ng
    integer, intent(in) :: nx_total
    integer, intent(in) :: ny_total
    real(dp), intent(in) :: U_in(nx_total, ny_total)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: U_L(nx + 1, ny)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: U_R(nx + 1, ny)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: U_B(nx, ny + 1)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: U_T(nx, ny + 1)
    logical, intent(out) :: grid_valid
    real(dp), allocatable :: sigma_x(:, :)
    real(dp), allocatable :: sigma_y(:, :)
    integer :: i, j, k, m, n, c, pci, pj

    ! step_01: input guard (reads no element of U_in)
    grid_valid = (ng >= 2) .and. (nx >= 1) .and. (ny >= 1) .and. &
      (nx_total == nx + 2*ng) .and. (ny_total == ny + 2*ng)

    ! step_06: rejection zero-fill, U_in untouched
    if (.not. grid_valid) then
      U_L = 0.0_dp
      U_R = 0.0_dp
      U_B = 0.0_dp
      U_T = 0.0_dp
      return
    end if

    allocate(sigma_x(nx + 2, ny))
    allocate(sigma_y(nx, ny + 2))

    ! step_02: MC slope in x at padded columns ng..ng+nx+1 of each interior row
    !$omp parallel do schedule(static) private(k, pj, c)
    do j = 1, ny
      pj = ng + j
      do k = 1, nx + 2
        c = ng + k - 1
        sigma_x(k, j) = mc_limiter(U_in(c, pj) - U_in(c - 1, pj), &
          U_in(c + 1, pj) - U_in(c, pj))
      end do
    end do
    !$omp end parallel do

    ! step_03: MC slope in y at padded rows ng..ng+ny+1 of each interior column
    !$omp parallel do schedule(static) private(i, pci, c)
    do k = 1, ny + 2
      c = ng + k - 1
      do i = 1, nx
        pci = ng + i
        sigma_y(i, k) = mc_limiter(U_in(pci, c) - U_in(pci, c - 1), &
          U_in(pci, c + 1) - U_in(pci, c))
      end do
    end do
    !$omp end parallel do

    ! step_04: x interface states, each cell uses its own slope on both faces
    !$omp parallel do schedule(static) private(m, pj)
    do j = 1, ny
      pj = ng + j
      do m = 1, nx + 1
        U_L(m, j) = U_in(ng + m - 1, pj) + 0.5_dp*sigma_x(m, j)
        U_R(m, j) = U_in(ng + m, pj) - 0.5_dp*sigma_x(m + 1, j)
      end do
    end do
    !$omp end parallel do

    ! step_05: y interface states
    !$omp parallel do schedule(static) private(i, pci)
    do n = 1, ny + 1
      do i = 1, nx
        pci = ng + i
        U_B(i, n) = U_in(pci, ng + n - 1) + 0.5_dp*sigma_y(i, n)
        U_T(i, n) = U_in(pci, ng + n) - 0.5_dp*sigma_y(i, n + 1)
      end do
    end do
    !$omp end parallel do

    deallocate(sigma_x)
    deallocate(sigma_y)
  end subroutine dynamics_shallow_water_reconstruction_2d_muscl_mc__reconstruct

  ! MC limited slope: 0 when a*b <= 0, else sign(a)*min(2|a|, 2|b|, |a+b|/2).
  pure function mc_limiter(a, b) result(s)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: a
    real(dp), intent(in) :: b
    real(dp) :: s
    if (a*b <= 0.0_dp) then
      s = 0.0_dp
    else
      s = sign(min(2.0_dp*abs(a), 2.0_dp*abs(b), 0.5_dp*abs(a + b)), a)
    end if
  end function mc_limiter

end module dynamics_shallow_water_reconstruction_2d_muscl_mc_model

! Checks module for the L0 suite of the MUSCL-MC reconstruction component.
module dynamics_shallow_water_reconstruction_2d_muscl_mc_checks
  use dynamics_shallow_water_reconstruction_2d_muscl_mc_model, only: dp, &
    dynamics_shallow_water_reconstruction_2d_muscl_mc__reconstruct
  implicit none
  private

  ! Bound snapshot state (captured by the host runner).
  real(dp), allocatable :: U_in(:, :)
  real(dp), allocatable :: U_L(:, :)
  real(dp), allocatable :: U_R(:, :)
  real(dp), allocatable :: U_B(:, :)
  real(dp), allocatable :: U_T(:, :)
  real(dp) :: grid_valid = -1.0_dp

  ! Current case grid (private).
  integer :: g_nx = 6
  integer :: g_ny = 4
  integer :: g_ng = 2
  integer :: g_nx_total = 10
  integer :: g_ny_total = 8

  integer, parameter :: f_unknown = 0
  integer, parameter :: f_bilinear = 1
  integer, parameter :: f_constant = 2
  integer, parameter :: f_extremum = 3
  integer, parameter :: f_step = 4
  integer, parameter :: f_cubic = 5
  integer, parameter :: f_invalid = 6

  public :: U_in, U_L, U_R, U_B, U_T, grid_valid
  public :: case_setup, case_run, get_time, checks_compute, metric_compute

contains

  function field_of(case_id) result(code)
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: case_id
    integer :: code
    select case (case_id)
    case ('l0_bilinear_field_exact_pass')
      code = f_bilinear
    case ('l0_constant_field_pass')
      code = f_constant
    case ('l0_extremum_zero_slope_pass')
      code = f_extremum
    case ('l0_step_bounded_pass')
      code = f_step
    case ('l0_mc_slope_value_pass')
      code = f_cubic
    case ('l0_invalid_ng_xfail', 'l0_invalid_nx_total_above_xfail', &
        'l0_invalid_nx_total_below_xfail', 'l0_invalid_ny_total_above_xfail', &
        'l0_invalid_ny_total_below_xfail')
      code = f_invalid
    case default
      code = f_unknown
    end select
  end function field_of

  function bilinear(x, y) result(v)
    real(dp), intent(in) :: x
    real(dp), intent(in) :: y
    real(dp) :: v
    v = 1.0_dp + 0.3_dp*x + 0.2_dp*y + 0.1_dp*x*y
  end function bilinear

  function field_value(code, i, j) result(v)
    integer, intent(in) :: code
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: j
    real(dp) :: v
    select case (code)
    case (f_constant)
      v = 2.5_dp
    case (f_extremum)
      v = 1.0_dp
      if (i == 5 .and. j == 4) v = 3.0_dp
    case (f_step)
      v = 0.0_dp
      if (i >= 6) v = 1.0_dp
    case (f_cubic)
      v = real((i - 5)**3 + (j - 4)**3, dp)
    case default
      v = bilinear(real(i, dp), real(j, dp))
    end select
  end function field_value

  subroutine reset_array(arr, n1, n2, val)
    real(dp), allocatable, intent(inout) :: arr(:, :)
    integer, intent(in) :: n1
    integer, intent(in) :: n2
    real(dp), intent(in) :: val
    if (allocated(arr)) deallocate(arr)
    allocate(arr(n1, n2))
    arr = val
  end subroutine reset_array

  subroutine case_setup(case_id, ok)
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: case_id
    logical, intent(out) :: ok
    integer :: code, fcode, i, j

    code = field_of(case_id)
    g_nx = 6
    g_ny = 4
    g_ng = 2
    g_nx_total = 10
    g_ny_total = 8
    select case (case_id)
    case ('l0_invalid_ng_xfail')
      g_ng = 1
      g_nx_total = 8
      g_ny_total = 6
    case ('l0_invalid_nx_total_above_xfail')
      g_nx_total = 11
    case ('l0_invalid_nx_total_below_xfail')
      g_nx_total = 9
    case ('l0_invalid_ny_total_above_xfail')
      g_ny_total = 9
    case ('l0_invalid_ny_total_below_xfail')
      g_ny_total = 7
    case default
      continue
    end select

    fcode = code
    if (code == f_invalid .or. code == f_unknown) fcode = f_bilinear

    call reset_array(U_in, g_nx_total, g_ny_total, 0.0_dp)
    do j = 1, g_ny_total
      do i = 1, g_nx_total
        U_in(i, j) = field_value(fcode, i, j)
      end do
    end do

    call reset_array(U_L, g_nx + 1, g_ny, -999.0_dp)
    call reset_array(U_R, g_nx + 1, g_ny, -999.0_dp)
    call reset_array(U_B, g_nx, g_ny + 1, -999.0_dp)
    call reset_array(U_T, g_nx, g_ny + 1, -999.0_dp)
    grid_valid = -1.0_dp

    ok = code /= f_unknown
  end subroutine case_setup

  subroutine case_run(case_id, steps, cells_updated, ok)
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: case_id
    integer, intent(out) :: steps
    integer, intent(out) :: cells_updated
    logical, intent(out) :: ok
    logical :: valid
    associate (unused_case_id => case_id); end associate

    call dynamics_shallow_water_reconstruction_2d_muscl_mc__reconstruct(g_nx, g_ny, g_ng, &
      g_nx_total, g_ny_total, U_in, U_L, U_R, U_B, U_T, valid)
    grid_valid = merge(1.0_dp, 0.0_dp, valid)

    steps = 1
    cells_updated = size(U_L) + size(U_R) + size(U_B) + size(U_T)
    ok = .true.
  end subroutine case_run

  subroutine get_time(t)
    real(dp), intent(out) :: t
    t = 0.0_dp
  end subroutine get_time

  ! Max component-wise deviation of the captured interface arrays from the
  ! expected arrays of the tests (closed forms and tables).
  function interface_deviation(code) result(dev)
    integer, intent(in) :: code
    real(dp) :: dev
    real(dp), parameter :: p_l(7) = [-13.0_dp, -1.5_dp, 0.0_dp, 0.5_dp, &
      2.0_dp, 14.5_dp, 41.0_dp]
    real(dp), parameter :: p_r(7) = [-14.5_dp, -2.0_dp, -0.5_dp, 0.0_dp, &
      1.5_dp, 13.0_dp, 39.5_dp]
    real(dp), parameter :: q_b(5) = [-1.5_dp, 0.0_dp, 0.5_dp, 2.0_dp, 14.5_dp]
    real(dp), parameter :: q_t(5) = [-2.0_dp, -0.5_dp, 0.0_dp, 1.5_dp, 13.0_dp]
    real(dp), allocatable :: e_l(:, :)
    real(dp), allocatable :: e_r(:, :)
    real(dp), allocatable :: e_b(:, :)
    real(dp), allocatable :: e_t(:, :)
    integer :: i, j, m, n, nxl, nyl

    nxl = size(U_B, 1)
    nyl = size(U_L, 2)
    allocate(e_l(nxl + 1, nyl))
    allocate(e_r(nxl + 1, nyl))
    allocate(e_b(nxl, nyl + 1))
    allocate(e_t(nxl, nyl + 1))

    do j = 1, nyl
      do m = 1, nxl + 1
        select case (code)
        case (f_bilinear)
          e_l(m, j) = bilinear(real(m, dp) + 1.5_dp, real(j + 2, dp))
          e_r(m, j) = e_l(m, j)
        case (f_cubic)
          e_l(m, j) = p_l(m) + real((j - 2)**3, dp)
          e_r(m, j) = p_r(m) + real((j - 2)**3, dp)
        case default
          e_l(m, j) = field_value(code, m + 1, j + 2)
          e_r(m, j) = field_value(code, m + 2, j + 2)
        end select
      end do
    end do

    do n = 1, nyl + 1
      do i = 1, nxl
        select case (code)
        case (f_bilinear)
          e_b(i, n) = bilinear(real(i + 2, dp), real(n, dp) + 1.5_dp)
          e_t(i, n) = e_b(i, n)
        case (f_cubic)
          e_b(i, n) = real((i - 3)**3, dp) + q_b(n)
          e_t(i, n) = real((i - 3)**3, dp) + q_t(n)
        case default
          e_b(i, n) = field_value(code, i + 2, n + 1)
          e_t(i, n) = field_value(code, i + 2, n + 2)
        end select
      end do
    end do

    dev = max(maxval(abs(U_L - e_l)), maxval(abs(U_R - e_r)), &
      maxval(abs(U_B - e_b)), maxval(abs(U_T - e_t)))
  end function interface_deviation

  function max_abs_interface() result(v)
    real(dp) :: v
    v = max(maxval(abs(U_L)), maxval(abs(U_R)), maxval(abs(U_B)), &
      maxval(abs(U_T)))
  end function max_abs_interface

  function guard_passed() result(flag)
    logical :: flag
    flag = abs(grid_valid - 1.0_dp) < 0.5_dp
  end function guard_passed

  function normal_status(code, want, tol) result(st)
    integer, intent(in) :: code
    integer, intent(in) :: want
    real(dp), intent(in) :: tol
    character(len=4) :: st
    if (code /= want) then
      st = 'na  '
    else if (.not. guard_passed()) then
      st = 'fail'
    else if (interface_deviation(code) <= tol) then
      st = 'pass'
    else
      st = 'fail'
    end if
  end function normal_status

  subroutine checks_compute(case_id, check_id, status)
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: case_id
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: check_id
    character(len=4), intent(out) :: status
    integer :: code

    code = field_of(case_id)
    select case (check_id)
    case ('bilinear_exact')
      status = normal_status(code, f_bilinear, 1.0e-12_dp)
    case ('constant')
      status = normal_status(code, f_constant, 0.0_dp)
    case ('extremum')
      status = normal_status(code, f_extremum, 0.0_dp)
    case ('step_bounded')
      status = normal_status(code, f_step, 0.0_dp)
    case ('slope_value')
      status = normal_status(code, f_cubic, 1.0e-12_dp)
    case ('rejected_outputs_zero')
      if (code /= f_invalid) then
        status = 'na  '
      else if (max_abs_interface() <= 0.0_dp) then
        status = 'pass'
      else
        status = 'fail'
      end if
    case ('input_guard')
      if (guard_passed()) then
        status = 'pass'
      else
        status = 'fail'
      end if
    case default
      status = 'na  '
    end select
  end subroutine checks_compute

  subroutine metric_compute(case_id, name, val, is_na, reason_na, found)
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: case_id
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: name
    real(dp), intent(out) :: val
    logical, intent(out) :: is_na
    character(len=:), allocatable, intent(out) :: reason_na
    logical, intent(out) :: found
    associate (unused_case_id => case_id); end associate
    associate (unused_name => name); end associate
    val = 0.0_dp
    is_na = .false.
    reason_na = ''
    found = .false.
  end subroutine metric_compute

end module dynamics_shallow_water_reconstruction_2d_muscl_mc_checks
